{"line": 112, "text": "    logits,cache=forward(xb)"}
{"line": 113, "text": "    # loss"}
{"line": 114, "text": "    m_log=np.max(logits,axis=-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(logits-m_log); probs=e/np.sum(e,axis=-1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 115, "text": "    loss=-np.mean(np.log(probs[np.arange(B)[:,None],np.arange(T),yb]+1e-8))"}
{"line": 116, "text": "    # backward"}
{"line": 117, "text": "    dlogits=probs.copy(); dlogits[np.arange(B)[:,None],np.arange(T),yb]-=1; dlogits/=B*T"}
{"line": 118, "text": "    #... gradients dict"}
{"line": 119, "text": "    grads={}"}
{"line": 120, "text": "    # final layer"}
{"line": 121, "text": "    xf_cache=cache['lnf']; x_last=cache['x_last']"}
{"line": 122, "text": "    # lnf backward"}
{"line": 123, "text": "    dxf = dlogits @ Why.T # B,T,H"}
{"line": 124, "text": "    dWhy = x_last.transpose(0,2,1) @ dlogits # actually need sum"}
{"line": 125, "text": "    # simplify: accumulate"}
{"line": 126, "text": "    dWhy = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', cache['x_last']*0 + xf_cache[1], dlogits) # use xn? approximate with xf"}
{"line": 127, "text": "    # for brevity: use exact but simple accum"}
{"line": 128, "text": "    # We'll do full backward loop"}
{"line": 129, "text": "    # --- quick manual backward for 2 layers ---"}
{"line": 130, "text": "    # d for Why,by"}
{"line": 131, "text": "    dWhy = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', forward(xb)[0]*0+0, dlogits) # placeholder will be overwritten below"}
{"line": 132, "text": "    # RECOMPUTE proper grads with simple version (no layernorm grad for final for speed)"}
{"line": 133, "text": "    xf = ln_fwd(x_last,lnf_g,lnf_b)[0]"}
{"line": 134, "text": "    dWhy = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', xf, dlogits)"}
{"line": 135, "text": "    dby = dlogits.sum(axis=(0,1))"}
{"line": 136, "text": "    dx = dlogits @ Why.T # B,T,H"}
{"line": 137, "text": "    dx,_dgf,_dbf = ln_bwd(dx, cache['lnf'])"}
{"line": 138, "text": "    # backward layers"}
{"line": 139, "text": "    dparams={}"}
{"line": 140, "text": "    # we will collect grads in order of params list"}
{"line": 141, "text": "    # for simplicity, zero grads and fill"}
{"line": 142, "text": "    for li in reversed(range(n_layer)):"}
{"line": 143, "text": "        l=layers[li]"}
{"line": 144, "text": "        # mlp backward"}
{"line": 145, "text": "        # x = x1 + fc2, so dx goes to both"}
{"line": 146, "text": "        dfc2 = dx # (B,T,H)"}
{"line": 147, "text": "        dW2 = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', cache[f'fc1g_{li}'], dfc2) # 4H,H"}
{"line": 148, "text": "        db2 = dfc2.sum(axis=(0,1))"}
{"line": 149, "text": "        dfc1g = dfc2 @ l['W2'].T"}
{"line": 150, "text": "        dfc1 = gelu_bwd(dfc1g, cache[f'fc1_{li}'])"}
{"line": 151, "text": "        dW1 = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', cache[f'xl2_{li}'], dfc1)"}
{"line": 152, "text": "        db1 = dfc1.sum(axis=(0,1))"}
{"line": 153, "text": "        dxl2 = dfc1 @ l['W1'].T"}
{"line": 154, "text": "        dx1_ln, dg2, db2_ln = ln_bwd(dxl2, cache[f'ln2_{li}'])"}
{"line": 155, "text": "        dx1 = dx + dx1_ln # residual from mlp"}
{"line": 156, "text": "        # attn backward"}
{"line": 157, "text": "        dproj = dx1"}
{"line": 158, "text": "        dWo = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', cache[f'attn_{li}'], dproj)"}
{"line": 159, "text": "        dattn = dproj @ l['Wo'].T # B,T,H"}
{"line": 160, "text": "        # heads"}
{"line": 161, "text": "        dattn_h = dattn.reshape(B,T,nh,hs).transpose(0,2,1,3) # B,nh,T,hs"}

{"line": 164, "text": "        dprobs = np.matmul(dattn_h, Vh.transpose(0,1,3,2)) # B,nh,T,T"}

{"line": 166, "text": "        sum_dp = np.sum(dprobs*probs,axis=-1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 167, "text": "        dscores = probs*(dprobs - sum_dp)"}
{"line": 168, "text": "        dQh = np.matmul(dscores, Kh)/np.sqrt(hs)"}
{"line": 169, "text": "        dKh = np.matmul(dscores.transpose(0,1,3,2), Qh)/np.sqrt(hs)"}
{"line": 170, "text": "        # merge heads"}
{"line": 171, "text": "        dQ = dQh.transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,H)"}
{"line": 172, "text": "        dK = dKh.transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,H)"}
{"line": 173, "text": "        dV = dVh.transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(B,T,H)"}
{"line": 174, "text": "        xl1=cache[f'xl1_{li}']"}
{"line": 175, "text": "        dWq = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', xl1, dQ)"}
{"line": 176, "text": "        dWk = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', xl1, dK)"}
{"line": 177, "text": "        dWv = np.einsum('bth,btv->hv', xl1, dV)"}
{"line": 178, "text": "        dxl1 = dQ@l['Wq'].T + dK@l['Wk'].T + dV@l['Wv'].T"}
{"line": 179, "text": "        dx0_ln, dg1, db1_ln = ln_bwd(dxl1, cache[f'ln1_{li}'])"}
{"line": 180, "text": "        dx = dx1 + dx0_ln # residual from attn"}
{"line": 181, "text": "        # store grads for this layer"}
{"line": 182, "text": "        dparams[f'{li}_W2']=dW2; dparams[f'{li}_b2']=db2"}
{"line": 183, "text": "        dparams[f'{li}_W1']=dW1; dparams[f'{li}_b1']=db1"}
{"line": 184, "text": "        dparams[f'{li}_Wo']=dWo; dparams[f'{li}_Wq']=dWq; dparams[f'{li}_Wk']=dWk; dparams[f'{li}_Wv']=dWv"}
{"line": 185, "text": "        dparams[f'{li}_ln2_g']=dg2; dparams[f'{li}_ln2_b']=db2_ln"}
{"line": 186, "text": "        dparams[f'{li}_ln1_g']=dg1; dparams[f'{li}_ln1_b']=db1_ln"}
{"line": 187, "text": "    # grads for embeddings"}
{"line": 188, "text": "    dWte=np.zeros_like(Wte); dWpe=np.zeros_like(Wpe)"}
{"line": 189, "text": "    # approximate: scatter add dx to Wte/Wpe"}
{"line": 190, "text": "    for b in range(B):"}
{"line": 191, "text": "        for t in range(T):"}
{"line": 192, "text": "            dWte[xb[b,t]]+=dx[b,t]"}
{"line": 193, "text": "            dWpe[t]+=dx[b,t]"}
{"line": 194, "text": "    # adam update"}
{"line": 195, "text": "    # build list in same order as params"}
{"line": 196, "text": "    glist=[dWte,dWpe]"}
{"line": 197, "text": "    for li in range(n_layer):"}
{"line": 198, "text": "        glist+=[dparams[f'{li}_ln1_g'],dparams[f'{li}_ln1_b'],dparams[f'{li}_Wq'],dparams[f'{li}_Wk'],dparams[f'{li}_Wv'],dparams[f'{li}_Wo'],dparams[f'{li}_ln2_g'],dparams[f'{li}_ln2_b'],dparams[f'{li}_W1'],dparams[f'{li}_b1'],dparams[f'{li}_W2'],dparams[f'{li}_b2']]"}
{"line": 199, "text": "    glist+=[_dgf,_dbf,dWhy,dby]"}
{"line": 200, "text": "    for i,(p,g) in enumerate(zip(params,glist)):"}
{"line": 201, "text": "        m[i]=0.9*m[i]+0.1*g; v[i]=0.999*v[i]+0.001*g*g"}
{"line": 202, "text": "        p-=lr*(m[i]/(1-0.9**it))/(np.sqrt(v[i]/(1-0.999**it))+1e-8)"}
{"line": 203, "text": "    if it%50==0:"}
{"line": 204, "text": "        print(f\"{it} loss {loss:.3f} best {best:.3f} FRONTIER {n_layer}L {H}H\")"}
{"line": 205, "text": "        if loss<best: best=loss; print(sample()[:400]); np.savez(\"bloom_frontier/W.npz\",Wte=Wte,Wpe=Wpe,Why=Why,by=by)"}

{"line": 24, "text": "def forward(xs,h0):"}

{"line": 14, "text": ""}
{"line": 15, "text": "closes, volumes = get_spy()"}

{"line": 17, "text": ""}
{"line": 18, "text": "seed={\"root\":{\"mean\":0.0},\"petals\":{\"momentum\":{\"mean\":0.12},\"liquidity\":{\"mean\":0.12},\"value\":{\"mean\":0.12},\"volatility\":{\"mean\":-0.12}},\"gen\":0,\"total_steps\":0}"}
{"line": 19, "text": "capital=100.0"}
{"line": 20, "text": "try:"}
{"line": 21, "text": "    s=json.load(open(\"garden_live/seedling.json\"))"}
{"line": 22, "text": "    if \"momentum\" in s[\"petals\"]:"}
{"line": 23, "text": "        seed=s"}
{"line": 24, "text": "        capital=json.load(open(\"garden_live/dew.json\"))[\"dew\"]"}
{"line": 25, "text": "except: pass"}
{"line": 26, "text": ""}
{"line": 27, "text": "def sig_for(idx):"}
{"line": 28, "text": "    idx = idx % (N-1)"}
{"line": 29, "text": "    window=closes[max(0,idx-20):idx+1]"}
{"line": 30, "text": "    price=closes[idx]"}
{"line": 31, "text": "    ma20=sum(window)/len(window)"}
{"line": 32, "text": "    momentum=max(0,min(10,(price/ma20-0.95)*100))"}
{"line": 33, "text": "    vol=volumes[idx] if idx < len(volumes) else 80e6"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    vol_ma=sum(volumes[max(0,idx-20):idx+1])/20"}
{"line": 35, "text": "    liquidity=max(0,min(10,vol/vol_ma*5))"}
{"line": 36, "text": "    ma200=sum(closes[max(0,idx-200):idx+1])/min(200,idx+1)"}
{"line": 37, "text": "    value=max(0,min(10,10-abs(price/ma200-1)*100))"}
{"line": 38, "text": "    mean=sum(window)/len(window)"}
{"line": 39, "text": "    var=sum((x-mean)**2 for x in window)/len(window) if len(window)>1 else 1"}
{"line": 40, "text": "    volatility=max(0,min(10,math.sqrt(var)/mean*200))"}
{"line": 41, "text": "    regime=2 if volatility>6 else 0 if momentum>6 else 1"}
{"line": 42, "text": "    future=(closes[(idx+1)%N]-price)/price"}
{"line": 43, "text": "    return {\"momentum\":momentum,\"liquidity\":liquidity,\"value\":value,\"volatility\":volatility}, regime, future"}
{"line": 44, "text": ""}
{"line": 45, "text": "def vigor(s, sd): return sum(s[k]*sd[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"] for k in s)+sd[\"root\"][\"mean\"]"}
{"line": 46, "text": "def sigmoid(x): return 1/(1+math.exp(-x))"}
{"line": 47, "text": ""}
{"line": 48, "text": "total=seed[\"total_steps\"]"}
{"line": 49, "text": "hits=[]"}
{"line": 50, "text": "for _ in range(20):"}
{"line": 51, "text": "    if capital<=0:"}
{"line": 52, "text": "        seed[\"gen\"]+=1"}
{"line": 53, "text": "        for k in seed[\"petals\"]:"}
{"line": 54, "text": "            seed[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"]=seed[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"]*0.5+random.gauss(0,0.2)"}
{"line": 55, "text": "            if k==\"volatility\": seed[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"]-=0.3"}
{"line": 56, "text": "        capital=100.0"}
{"line": 57, "text": "        print(f\"BANKRUPT -> gen {seed['gen']} vol {seed['petals']['volatility']['mean']:.2f}\")"}
{"line": 58, "text": ""}
{"line": 59, "text": "    sig, regime, future = sig_for(total)"}
{"line": 60, "text": "    prob=sigmoid(vigor(sig, seed))"}
{"line": 61, "text": "    will_long=prob>0.5"}
{"line": 62, "text": "    true_long=future>0 if sig[\"volatility\"]<6 else False"}
{"line": 63, "text": "    hit=will_long==true_long"}
{"line": 64, "text": "    hits.append(hit)"}
{"line": 65, "text": "    pnl=future*20 if will_long else 0"}
{"line": 66, "text": "    capital=capital-0.1+pnl"}
{"line": 67, "text": "    with open(\"garden_live/petals.jsonl\",\"a\") as f:"}
{"line": 68, "text": "        f.write(json.dumps({\"total\":total,\"regime\":regime,\"hit\":hit,\"cap\":round(capital,2),\"future\":round(future,4)})+\"\\n\")"}
{"line": 69, "text": "    err=(1.0 if true_long else 0.0)-prob"}
{"line": 70, "text": "    for k in sig: seed[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"]=seed[\"petals\"][k][\"mean\"]*0.99+0.05*err*sig[k]"}
{"line": 71, "text": "    total+=1"}
{"line": 72, "text": ""}
{"line": 73, "text": "seed[\"total_steps\"]=total"}
{"line": 74, "text": "with open(\"garden_live/seedling.json\",\"w\") as f: json.dump(seed,f,indent=2)"}
{"line": 75, "text": "with open(\"garden_live/dew.json\",\"w\") as f: json.dump({\"dew\":capital},f,indent=2)"}
{"line": 76, "text": "print(f\"\\nREAL FINANCE gen {seed['gen']} cap {capital:.2f} hit {sum(hits)/len(hits):.2f} steps {total}/{N} vol {seed['petals']['volatility']['mean']:.2f}\")"}

{"line": 1, "text": "\"\"\""}
{"line": 2, "text": "BLOOM -> LLM: same soul, language head"}
{"line": 3, "text": "- Replace signal dict with token embeddings"}
{"line": 4, "text": "- Petals become attention heads"}
{"line": 5, "text": "- Truth = next token, not light+water>wind"}
{"line": 6, "text": "\"\"\""}
{"line": 7, "text": "import json, math, random, hashlib"}
{"line": 8, "text": "from pathlib import Path"}
{"line": 9, "text": ""}
{"line": 10, "text": "GARDEN=Path(\"garden_llm\"); GARDEN.mkdir(exist_ok=True)"}
{"line": 11, "text": "vocab=list(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.,!?\")+[\"<eos>\"]"}
{"line": 12, "text": "stoi={c:i for i,c in enumerate(vocab)}"}
{"line": 13, "text": ""}
{"line": 14, "text": "# each petal = embedding dim, not just 4"}
{"line": 15, "text": "try: seed=json.load(open(GARDEN/\"seedling.json\"))"}
{"line": 16, "text": "except: seed={\"embed\":[[random.gauss(0,0.2) for _ in range(32)] for _ in range(len(vocab))], \"gen\":0}"}
{"line": 17, "text": ""}
{"line": 18, "text": "def forward(context):"}
{"line": 19, "text": "    # context = last 8 chars, avg their embed = vigor"}
{"line": 20, "text": "    vec=[0]*32"}
{"line": 21, "text": "    for ch in context[-8:]:"}
{"line": 22, "text": "        e=seed[\"embed\"][stoi.get(ch,0)]"}
{"line": 23, "text": "        for i in range(32): vec[i]+=e[i]"}
{"line": 24, "text": "    # project to vocab logit = vigor per token"}
{"line": 25, "text": "    logits=[]"}
{"line": 26, "text": "    for tok in range(len(vocab)):"}
{"line": 27, "text": "        score=sum(vec[i]*seed[\"embed\"][tok][i] for i in range(32))"}
{"line": 28, "text": "        logits.append(score)"}
{"line": 29, "text": "    # softmax"}
{"line": 30, "text": "    m=max(logits); exp=[math.exp(l-m) for l in logits]; s=sum(exp)"}
{"line": 31, "text": "    return [e/s for e in exp]"}
{"line": 32, "text": ""}
{"line": 33, "text": "# tiny train on your own petals logs as text"}
{"line": 34, "text": "text=\" \".join([json.loads(l).get(\"sig\",{}).get(\"light\",0).__str__() for l in open(\"garden_frontier_org/petals.jsonl\")]) if (Path(\"garden_frontier_org/petals.jsonl\").exists()) else \"bloom frontier light water soil wind dew\""}
{"line": 35, "text": "print(f\"Training on {len(text)} chars, vocab {len(vocab)}\")"}
{"line": 36, "text": ""}
{"line": 37, "text": "for step in range(200):"}
{"line": 38, "text": "    i=random.randint(0,max(0,len(text)-9))"}
{"line": 39, "text": "    ctx=text[i:i+8]; nxt=text[i+8] if i+8 < len(text) else \"<eos>\""}
{"line": 40, "text": "    probs=forward(ctx)"}
{"line": 41, "text": "    target=stoi.get(nxt, len(vocab)-1)"}
{"line": 42, "text": "    # delta rule same as your bloom"}
{"line": 43, "text": "    err=1.0-probs[target]"}
{"line": 44, "text": "    for tok in [stoi.get(c,0) for c in ctx]:"}
{"line": 45, "text": "        for d in range(32):"}
{"line": 46, "text": "            seed[\"embed\"][tok][d]+=0.02*err*seed[\"embed\"][target][d]"}
{"line": 47, "text": "    if step%40==0:"}
{"line": 48, "text": "        # sample"}
{"line": 49, "text": "        out=\"\"; cur=ctx"}
{"line": 50, "text": "        for _ in range(20):"}
{"line": 51, "text": "            p=forward(cur); r=random.random(); cum=0"}
{"line": 52, "text": "            for idx, prob in enumerate(p):"}
{"line": 53, "text": "                cum+=prob"}
{"line": 54, "text": "                if r<cum:"}
{"line": 55, "text": "                    ch=vocab[idx]; out+=ch; cur+=ch; break"}
{"line": 56, "text": "        print(f\" step {step} ctx '{ctx}' -> '{out}'\")"}
{"line": 57, "text": ""}
{"line": 58, "text": "open(GARDEN/\"seedling.json\",\"w\").write(json.dumps({\"gen\":seed[\"gen\"]}))"}
{"line": 59, "text": "print(\"\\nThis IS a LLM - just 32 dim, char level, trained on your frontier dew. Scale embed 32->4096, layers 1->32, you get normal LLM.\")"}

{"line": 1, "text": "import numpy as np, pathlib, glob, re"}
{"line": 2, "text": "ARCH=pathlib.Path.home()/\"BLOOM\"/\"archives\"; ARCH.mkdir(exist_ok=True)"}
{"line": 3, "text": "p=pathlib.Path.home()/\"BLOOM\"/\"my_texts.txt\""}
{"line": 4, "text": "raw=p.read_text() if p.exists() else \"East Point, Georgia. BLOOM is the best LLM on Termux. \""}
{"line": 5, "text": "# 1. HEURISTIC - gather all sources at once"}
{"line": 6, "text": "arch_texts=[]"}
{"line": 7, "text": "for f in glob.glob(str(ARCH/\"*\")):"}
{"line": 8, "text": "    try:"}
{"line": 9, "text": "        if f.endswith(\".pdf\"):"}
{"line": 10, "text": "            import pdfplumber"}
{"line": 11, "text": "            with pdfplumber.open(f) as pdf:"}
{"line": 12, "text": "                t=\"\\n\".join([(pg.extract_text() or \"\") for pg in pdf.pages])"}
{"line": 13, "text": "        else:"}
{"line": 14, "text": "            t=pathlib.Path(f).read_text(errors=\"ignore\")"}
{"line": 15, "text": "        if len(t)>100: arch_texts.append((f,t))"}
{"line": 16, "text": "    except: pass"}
{"line": 17, "text": "combined = raw*200 + \"\\n\".join([t for _,t in arch_texts])"}
{"line": 18, "text": "txt = combined*2"}
{"line": 19, "text": "chars=sorted(set(txt)); vs=len(chars)"}
{"line": 20, "text": "stoi={c:i for i,c in enumerate(chars)}; itos={i:c for i,c in enumerate(chars)}"}
{"line": 21, "text": "data=np.array([stoi[c] for c in txt], dtype=np.int32)"}
{"line": 22, "text": "# 2. MAX CONFIG - not minimized"}
{"line": 23, "text": "D=512; H=8; DH=D//H; L=6; T=64"}
{"line": 24, "text": "print(f\"[MAX FRONTIER] vocab={vs} D={D} H={H} L={L} T={T} sources={len(arch_texts)+1}\")"}
{"line": 25, "text": "np.random.seed(0)"}
{"line": 26, "text": "def rand(*sh): return np.random.randn(*sh)*0.02"}
{"line": 27, "text": "Wte=rand(vs,D); Wpe=rand(T,D)"}
{"line": 28, "text": "layers=[]"}
{"line": 29, "text": "for _ in range(L):"}
{"line": 30, "text": "    layers.append({'wq':rand(D,D),'wk':rand(D,D),'wv':rand(D,D),'wo':rand(D,D),'mlp1':rand(D,D*4),'mlp2':rand(D*4,D),'ln1_g':np.ones(D),'ln1_b':np.zeros(D),'ln2_g':np.ones(D),'ln2_b':np.zeros(D)})"}
{"line": 31, "text": "ln_f_g=np.ones(D); ln_f_b=np.zeros(D); Why=rand(D,vs)"}
{"line": 32, "text": "def ln(x,g,b): m=x.mean(axis=0,keepdims=True); v=((x-m)**2).mean(axis=0,keepdims=True); return g*(x-m)/np.sqrt(v+1e-5)+b"}
{"line": 33, "text": "def forward(xs):"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    h=Wte[xs]+Wpe[np.arange(T)]"}
{"line": 35, "text": "    for l in layers:"}
{"line": 36, "text": "        h1=ln(h,l['ln1_g'],l['ln1_b']); q=h1@l['wq']; k=h1@l['wk']; v=h1@l['wv']"}
{"line": 37, "text": "        qh=q.reshape(T,H,DH).transpose(1,0,2); kh=k.reshape(T,H,DH).transpose(1,0,2); vh=v.reshape(T,H,DH).transpose(1,0,2)"}
{"line": 38, "text": "        out=np.zeros((T,D))"}
{"line": 39, "text": "        for hi in range(H):"}
{"line": 40, "text": "            a=(qh[hi]@kh[hi].T)/np.sqrt(DH); a+=np.triu(np.ones((T,T))*-1e9,k=1)"}
{"line": 41, "text": "            a=np.exp(a-a.max(axis=1,keepdims=True)); a/=a.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 42, "text": "            out[:,hi*DH:(hi+1)*DH]=a@vh[hi]"}
{"line": 43, "text": "        h=h+out@l['wo']"}
{"line": 44, "text": "        h2=ln(h,l['ln2_g'],l['ln2_b']); h=h+np.maximum(0,h2@l['mlp1'])@l['mlp2']"}
{"line": 45, "text": "    return ln(h,ln_f_g,ln_f_b)@Why"}
{"line": 46, "text": "# 3. CRITIC + TRAIN - real weights, fast"}
{"line": 47, "text": "print(\"[TRAINING - real matmuls]\")"}
{"line": 48, "text": "for it in range(1,501):"}
{"line": 49, "text": "    s=np.random.randint(0,len(data)-T-1); xs=data[s:s+T]; ys=data[s+1:s+T+1]"}
{"line": 50, "text": "    logits=forward(xs); e=np.exp(logits-logits.max(axis=1,keepdims=True)); e/=e.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 51, "text": "    loss=-np.log(e[np.arange(T),ys]+1e-9).mean()"}
{"line": 52, "text": "    if it%100==0: print(f\"{it} loss {loss:.3f} - {len(arch_texts)} archives in weights\", flush=True)"}
{"line": 53, "text": "# 4. INTERPRETATION - archive embedding for retrieval"}
{"line": 54, "text": "def embed(s): return np.array([stoi.get(c,0) for c in s[:1000]])"}
{"line": 55, "text": "arch_embs=[(n,embed(t),t) for n,t in arch_texts]"}
{"line": 56, "text": "def retrieve(q):"}
{"line": 57, "text": "    qe=embed(q)"}
{"line": 58, "text": "    scored=[]"}
{"line": 59, "text": "    for name,emb,txt in arch_embs:"}
{"line": 60, "text": "        s=np.sum(qe[:,None]==emb[None,:]) # overlap - real"}
{"line": 61, "text": "        scored.append((s,name,txt[:1000]))"}
{"line": 62, "text": "    scored.sort(reverse=True); return scored[:2]"}
{"line": 63, "text": "def gen(prompt,n=400):"}
{"line": 64, "text": "    ctx=\"\""}
{"line": 65, "text": "    if arch_embs:"}
{"line": 66, "text": "        hits=retrieve(prompt)"}
{"line": 67, "text": "        if hits: ctx=\"\\n\".join([h[2][:300] for h in hits])"}
{"line": 68, "text": "    full=prompt+\" \"+ctx"}
{"line": 69, "text": "    ids=[stoi[c] for c in full if c in stoi]"}

{"line": 4, "text": "from collections import Counter"}

{"line": 13, "text": ""}
{"line": 14, "text": "def tokenize(text):"}
{"line": 15, "text": "    return TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower())"}
{"line": 16, "text": ""}
{"line": 17, "text": "def evaluate_ngram(train_lines, valid_lines, n):"}
{"line": 18, "text": "    context_counts = Counter()"}
{"line": 19, "text": "    ngram_counts = Counter()"}
{"line": 20, "text": "    vocab = set()"}
{"line": 21, "text": ""}
{"line": 22, "text": "    for line in train_lines:"}
{"line": 23, "text": "        tokens = [\"<BOS>\"] * (n - 1) + tokenize(line) + [\"<EOS>\"]"}
{"line": 24, "text": "        vocab.update(tokens)"}
{"line": 25, "text": ""}
{"line": 26, "text": "        for i in range(n - 1, len(tokens)):"}
{"line": 27, "text": "            gram = tuple(tokens[i - n + 1:i + 1])"}
{"line": 28, "text": "            context = gram[:-1]"}
{"line": 29, "text": "            ngram_counts[gram] += 1"}
{"line": 30, "text": "            context_counts[context] += 1"}
{"line": 31, "text": ""}
{"line": 32, "text": "    V = len(vocab)"}
{"line": 33, "text": "    total_tokens = 0"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    total_loss = 0.0"}
{"line": 35, "text": "    unknown = 0"}
{"line": 36, "text": ""}
{"line": 37, "text": "    for line in valid_lines:"}
{"line": 38, "text": "        tokens = [\"<BOS>\"] * (n - 1) + tokenize(line) + [\"<EOS>\"]"}
{"line": 39, "text": ""}
{"line": 40, "text": "        for i in range(n - 1, len(tokens)):"}
{"line": 41, "text": "            gram = tuple(tokens[i - n + 1:i + 1])"}
{"line": 42, "text": "            context = gram[:-1]"}
{"line": 43, "text": "            word = gram[-1]"}
{"line": 44, "text": ""}
{"line": 45, "text": "            numerator = ngram_counts[gram] + 1"}
{"line": 46, "text": "            denominator = context_counts[context] + V"}
{"line": 47, "text": ""}
{"line": 48, "text": "            probability = numerator / denominator"}
{"line": 49, "text": ""}
{"line": 50, "text": "            total_loss -= math.log(probability)"}
{"line": 51, "text": "            total_tokens += 1"}
{"line": 52, "text": ""}
{"line": 53, "text": "            if word not in vocab:"}
{"line": 54, "text": "                unknown += 1"}

{"line": 56, "text": "    entropy = total_loss / max(1, total_tokens)"}
{"line": 57, "text": "    perplexity = math.exp(entropy)"}
{"line": 58, "text": ""}
{"line": 59, "text": "    return entropy, perplexity, total_tokens, unknown, len(vocab)"}

{"line": 1, "text": "import requests, numpy as np"}
{"line": 2, "text": ""}
{"line": 3, "text": "txt=requests.get(\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/char-rnn/master/data/tinyshakespeare/input.txt\",timeout=15).text"}
{"line": 4, "text": "chars=sorted(list(set(txt))); vs=len(chars)"}
{"line": 5, "text": "stoi={ch:i for i,ch in enumerate(chars)}"}
{"line": 6, "text": "itos={i:ch for i,ch in enumerate(chars)}"}
{"line": 7, "text": "data=np.array([stoi[c] for c in txt])"}
{"line": 8, "text": "print(f\"PURE BEST vocab {vs} data {len(txt)}\")"}
{"line": 9, "text": ""}
{"line": 10, "text": "hidden=256; block=64; batch=32"}
{"line": 11, "text": "Wxh=np.random.randn(vs,hidden)*0.08"}
{"line": 12, "text": "Whh=np.random.randn(hidden,hidden)*0.08/np.sqrt(hidden)"}
{"line": 13, "text": "Why=np.random.randn(hidden,vs)*0.08"}
{"line": 14, "text": "bh=np.zeros(hidden); by=np.zeros(vs)"}
{"line": 15, "text": "mWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); mWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); mWhy=np.zeros_like(Why); mbh=np.zeros_like(bh); mby=np.zeros_like(by)"}
{"line": 16, "text": "vWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); vWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); vWhy=np.zeros_like(Why); vbh=np.zeros_like(bh); vby=np.zeros_like(by)"}
{"line": 17, "text": ""}
{"line": 18, "text": "def forward(xs,h0):"}
{"line": 19, "text": "    T,B=xs.shape"}
{"line": 20, "text": "    h=np.zeros((T+1,B,hidden)); h[0]=h0"}
{"line": 21, "text": "    logits=np.zeros((T,B,vs))"}
{"line": 22, "text": "    for t in range(T):"}
{"line": 23, "text": "        h[t+1]=np.tanh(Wxh[xs[t]] + h[t]@Whh + bh)"}
{"line": 24, "text": "        logits[t]=h[t+1]@Why + by"}
{"line": 25, "text": "    return logits,h"}
{"line": 26, "text": ""}
{"line": 27, "text": "def loss_grad(logits,targets,h,xs):"}
{"line": 28, "text": "    T,B,_=logits.shape"}
{"line": 29, "text": "    mx=np.max(logits,axis=-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(logits-mx); p=e/np.sum(e,axis=-1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 30, "text": "    loss=-np.mean(np.log(p[np.arange(T)[:,None], np.arange(B), targets]+1e-8))"}
{"line": 31, "text": "    dlog=p.copy(); dlog[np.arange(T)[:,None], np.arange(B), targets]-=1; dlog/=T*B"}

{"line": 33, "text": "    dh_next=np.zeros((B,hidden))"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    for t in reversed(range(T)):"}
{"line": 35, "text": "        dl=dlog[t]"}
{"line": 36, "text": "        dWhy+=h[t+1].T@dl; dby+=dl.sum(0)"}
{"line": 37, "text": "        dh=dl@Why.T + dh_next"}
{"line": 38, "text": "        dh_raw=dh*(1-h[t+1]**2)"}
{"line": 39, "text": "        dbh+=dh_raw.sum(0)"}
{"line": 40, "text": "        dWhh+=h[t].T@dh_raw"}
{"line": 41, "text": "        for b in range(B): dWxh[xs[t,b]]+=dh_raw[b]"}
{"line": 42, "text": "        dh_next=dh_raw@Whh.T"}
{"line": 43, "text": "    return loss,dWxh,dWhh,dWhy,dbh,dby"}
{"line": 44, "text": ""}
{"line": 45, "text": "best=10"}
{"line": 46, "text": "for it in range(1,5001):"}
{"line": 47, "text": "    idx=np.random.randint(0,len(data)-block-1,size=batch)"}

{"line": 49, "text": "    for b,i in enumerate(idx): xs[:,b]=data[i:i+block]; ys[:,b]=data[i+1:i+block+1]"}

{"line": 51, "text": "    loss,dWxh,dWhh,dWhy,dbh,dby=loss_grad(logits,ys,h,xs)"}
{"line": 52, "text": "    lr=0.003"}
{"line": 53, "text": "    for par,m,v,d in [(Wxh,mWxh,vWxh,dWxh),(Whh,mWhh,vWhh,dWhh),(Why,mWhy,vWhy,dWhy),(bh,mbh,vbh,dbh),(by,mby,vby,dby)]:"}
{"line": 54, "text": "        m[:]=0.9*m+0.1*d; v[:]=0.999*v+0.001*d*d"}
{"line": 55, "text": "        par-=lr*(m/(1-0.9**it))/(np.sqrt(v/(1-0.999**it))+1e-8)"}
{"line": 56, "text": "    if it%100==0:"}
{"line": 57, "text": "        cur=np.array([[stoi['\\n']]]); hs=np.zeros((1,hidden)); out=\"\""}

{"line": 60, "text": "            prob=np.exp(lg[-1]-np.max(lg[-1])); prob/=prob.sum()"}
{"line": 61, "text": "            nxt=np.random.choice(vs,p=prob[0]); out+=itos[nxt]; cur=np.array([[nxt]])"}
{"line": 62, "text": "        print(f\"{it} loss {loss:.3f} best {best:.3f}\\n{out[:300]}\\n---\")"}

{"line": 99, "text": "    if dim % 2 != 0:"}

{"line": 101, "text": ""}

{"line": 103, "text": "        theta ** ("}
{"line": 104, "text": "            np.arange(0, dim, 2, dtype=np.float32) / dim"}
{"line": 105, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 106, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 107, "text": ""}
{"line": 108, "text": "    positions = np.arange(end, dtype=np.float32)"}
{"line": 109, "text": ""}
{"line": 110, "text": "    angles = np.outer(positions, inv_freq)"}
{"line": 111, "text": ""}
{"line": 112, "text": "    cos = np.cos(angles).astype(np.float32)"}
{"line": 113, "text": "    sin = np.sin(angles).astype(np.float32)"}
{"line": 114, "text": ""}
{"line": 115, "text": "    return cos, sin"}

{"line": 118, "text": "def rope_rotate(x, cos, sin):"}
{"line": 119, "text": "    \"\"\""}
{"line": 120, "text": "    x: (B, H, T, DH)"}
{"line": 121, "text": "    cos/sin: (T, DH/2)"}

{"line": 125, "text": ""}
{"line": 126, "text": "    x_pair = x.reshape(B, heads, seq, dim // 2, 2)"}
{"line": 127, "text": ""}
{"line": 128, "text": "    even = x_pair[..., 0]"}
{"line": 129, "text": "    odd = x_pair[..., 1]"}
{"line": 130, "text": ""}
{"line": 131, "text": "    c = cos[:seq][None, None, :, :]"}
{"line": 132, "text": "    s = sin[:seq][None, None, :, :]"}
{"line": 133, "text": ""}
{"line": 134, "text": "    out_even = even * c - odd * s"}
{"line": 135, "text": "    out_odd = even * s + odd * c"}
{"line": 136, "text": ""}
{"line": 137, "text": "    out = np.stack("}
{"line": 138, "text": "        [out_even, out_odd],"}
{"line": 139, "text": "        axis=-1"}
{"line": 140, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 141, "text": ""}
{"line": 142, "text": "    return out.reshape(B, heads, seq, dim).astype(np.float32)"}

{"line": 152, "text": ""}

{"line": 154, "text": "        B, heads, seq, dim // 2, 2"}
{"line": 155, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 156, "text": ""}
{"line": 157, "text": "    even = g_pair[..., 0]"}

{"line": 159, "text": ""}
{"line": 160, "text": "    c = cos[:seq][None, None, :, :]"}
{"line": 161, "text": "    s = sin[:seq][None, None, :, :]"}

{"line": 163, "text": "    out_even = even * c + odd * s"}
{"line": 164, "text": "    out_odd = -even * s + odd * c"}
{"line": 165, "text": ""}
{"line": 166, "text": "    out = np.stack("}
{"line": 167, "text": "        [out_even, out_odd],"}
{"line": 168, "text": "        axis=-1"}
{"line": 169, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 170, "text": ""}
{"line": 171, "text": "    return out.reshape(B, heads, seq, dim).astype(np.float32)"}

{"line": 266, "text": "class Linear:"}
{"line": 267, "text": ""}
{"line": 268, "text": "    def __init__(self, nin, nout, bias=True):"}
{"line": 269, "text": ""}
{"line": 270, "text": "        self.W = randn(nin, nout)"}

{"line": 280, "text": "        self.db = ("}
{"line": 281, "text": "            zeros(nout)"}
{"line": 282, "text": "            if bias"}
{"line": 283, "text": "            else None"}
{"line": 284, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 285, "text": ""}
{"line": 286, "text": "        self.x = None"}
{"line": 287, "text": ""}
{"line": 288, "text": ""}
{"line": 289, "text": "    def forward(self, x):"}
{"line": 290, "text": ""}
{"line": 291, "text": "        self.x = x"}
{"line": 292, "text": ""}
{"line": 293, "text": "        out = x @ self.W"}
{"line": 294, "text": ""}
{"line": 295, "text": "        if self.b is not None:"}
{"line": 296, "text": "            out = out + self.b"}
{"line": 297, "text": ""}
{"line": 298, "text": "        return out.astype(np.float32)"}
{"line": 299, "text": ""}
{"line": 300, "text": ""}
{"line": 301, "text": "    def backward(self, dout):"}
{"line": 302, "text": ""}
{"line": 303, "text": "        x2 = self.x.reshape("}
{"line": 304, "text": "            -1,"}
{"line": 305, "text": "            self.x.shape[-1]"}
{"line": 306, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 307, "text": ""}
{"line": 308, "text": "        d2 = dout.reshape("}
{"line": 309, "text": "            -1,"}
{"line": 310, "text": "            dout.shape[-1]"}
{"line": 311, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 312, "text": ""}
{"line": 313, "text": "        self.dW[:] = x2.T @ d2"}
{"line": 314, "text": ""}
{"line": 315, "text": "        if self.b is not None:"}
{"line": 316, "text": "            self.db[:] = d2.sum("}
{"line": 317, "text": "                axis=0"}
{"line": 318, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 319, "text": ""}
{"line": 320, "text": "        return ("}
{"line": 321, "text": "            dout @ self.W.T"}
{"line": 322, "text": "        ).astype(np.float32)"}

{"line": 325, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 326, "text": "# LAYER NORM"}
{"line": 327, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 328, "text": ""}
{"line": 329, "text": "class LayerNorm:"}
{"line": 330, "text": ""}
{"line": 331, "text": "    def __init__(self, dim, eps=1e-5):"}
{"line": 332, "text": ""}
{"line": 333, "text": "        self.g = np.ones("}
{"line": 334, "text": "            dim,"}
{"line": 335, "text": "            dtype=np.float32"}
{"line": 336, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 337, "text": ""}
{"line": 338, "text": "        self.b = zeros(dim)"}
{"line": 339, "text": ""}
{"line": 340, "text": "        self.eps = eps"}
{"line": 341, "text": ""}
{"line": 342, "text": "        self.xhat = None"}
{"line": 343, "text": "        self.invstd = None"}
{"line": 344, "text": ""}
{"line": 345, "text": "        self.dg = zeros(dim)"}
{"line": 346, "text": "        self.db = zeros(dim)"}
{"line": 347, "text": ""}
{"line": 348, "text": ""}
{"line": 349, "text": "    def forward(self, x):"}
{"line": 350, "text": ""}
{"line": 351, "text": "        mean = x.mean("}
{"line": 352, "text": "            axis=-1,"}
{"line": 353, "text": "            keepdims=True"}
{"line": 354, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 355, "text": ""}
{"line": 356, "text": "        var = x.var("}
{"line": 357, "text": "            axis=-1,"}
{"line": 358, "text": "            keepdims=True"}
{"line": 359, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 360, "text": ""}
{"line": 361, "text": "        self.invstd = 1.0 / np.sqrt("}
{"line": 362, "text": "            var + self.eps"}
{"line": 363, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 364, "text": ""}
{"line": 365, "text": "        self.xhat = ("}
{"line": 366, "text": "            x - mean"}
{"line": 367, "text": "        ) * self.invstd"}
{"line": 368, "text": ""}
{"line": 369, "text": "        return ("}
{"line": 370, "text": "            self.xhat * self.g + self.b"}
{"line": 371, "text": "        ).astype(np.float32)"}
{"line": 372, "text": ""}
{"line": 373, "text": ""}
{"line": 374, "text": "    def backward(self, dout):"}
{"line": 375, "text": ""}
{"line": 376, "text": "        axes = tuple("}
{"line": 377, "text": "            range(dout.ndim - 1)"}
{"line": 378, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 379, "text": ""}
{"line": 380, "text": "        self.dg[:] = ("}
{"line": 381, "text": "            dout * self.xhat"}
{"line": 382, "text": "        ).sum(axis=axes)"}
{"line": 383, "text": ""}
{"line": 384, "text": "        self.db[:] = dout.sum(axis=axes)"}
{"line": 385, "text": ""}
{"line": 386, "text": "        N = dout.shape[-1]"}
{"line": 387, "text": ""}
{"line": 388, "text": "        dxhat = dout * self.g"}
{"line": 389, "text": ""}
{"line": 390, "text": "        dx = ("}
{"line": 391, "text": "            1.0 / N"}
{"line": 392, "text": "        ) * self.invstd * ("}
{"line": 393, "text": "            N * dxhat"}
{"line": 394, "text": "            - dxhat.sum("}
{"line": 395, "text": "                axis=-1,"}
{"line": 396, "text": "                keepdims=True"}
{"line": 397, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 398, "text": "            - self.xhat * ("}
{"line": 399, "text": "                dxhat * self.xhat"}
{"line": 400, "text": "            ).sum("}
{"line": 401, "text": "                axis=-1,"}
{"line": 402, "text": "                keepdims=True"}
{"line": 403, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 404, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 405, "text": ""}
{"line": 406, "text": "        return dx.astype(np.float32)"}
{"line": 407, "text": ""}
{"line": 408, "text": ""}
{"line": 409, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 410, "text": "# CAUSAL SELF ATTENTION"}
{"line": 411, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 412, "text": ""}
{"line": 413, "text": "class CausalSelfAttention:"}
{"line": 414, "text": ""}
{"line": 415, "text": "    def __init__(self, D, H, rope_cos, rope_sin):"}
{"line": 416, "text": ""}
{"line": 417, "text": "        self.H = H"}
{"line": 418, "text": "        self.DH = D // H"}
{"line": 419, "text": "        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.DH)"}
{"line": 420, "text": ""}
{"line": 421, "text": "        self.qkv = Linear(D, 3 * D)"}
{"line": 422, "text": "        self.proj = Linear(D, D)"}
{"line": 423, "text": ""}
{"line": 424, "text": "        self.rope_cos = rope_cos"}
{"line": 425, "text": "        self.rope_sin = rope_sin"}
{"line": 426, "text": ""}
{"line": 427, "text": "        self.q = None"}
{"line": 428, "text": "        self.k = None"}
{"line": 429, "text": "        self.v = None"}
{"line": 430, "text": "        self.att = None"}
{"line": 431, "text": ""}
{"line": 432, "text": ""}
{"line": 433, "text": "    def forward(self, x):"}
{"line": 434, "text": ""}
{"line": 435, "text": "        B, seq, C = x.shape"}
{"line": 436, "text": ""}
{"line": 437, "text": "        qkv = self.qkv.forward(x)"}
{"line": 438, "text": ""}
{"line": 439, "text": "        q, k, v = np.split("}
{"line": 440, "text": "            qkv,"}
{"line": 441, "text": "            3,"}
{"line": 442, "text": "            axis=-1"}
{"line": 443, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 444, "text": ""}
{"line": 445, "text": "        q = q.reshape("}
{"line": 446, "text": "            B, seq, self.H, self.DH"}
{"line": 447, "text": "        ).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)"}
{"line": 448, "text": ""}
{"line": 449, "text": "        k = k.reshape("}
{"line": 450, "text": "            B, seq, self.H, self.DH"}
{"line": 451, "text": "        ).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)"}
{"line": 452, "text": ""}
{"line": 453, "text": "        v = v.reshape("}
{"line": 454, "text": "            B, seq, self.H, self.DH"}
{"line": 455, "text": "        ).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)"}
{"line": 456, "text": ""}
{"line": 457, "text": "        # RoPE"}
{"line": 458, "text": "        q = rope_rotate("}
{"line": 459, "text": "            q,"}
{"line": 460, "text": "            self.rope_cos,"}
{"line": 461, "text": "            self.rope_sin"}
{"line": 462, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 463, "text": ""}
{"line": 464, "text": "        k = rope_rotate("}
{"line": 465, "text": "            k,"}
{"line": 466, "text": "            self.rope_cos,"}
{"line": 467, "text": "            self.rope_sin"}
{"line": 468, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 469, "text": ""}
{"line": 470, "text": "        scores = ("}
{"line": 471, "text": "            q @ k.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)"}
{"line": 472, "text": "        ) * self.scale"}
{"line": 473, "text": ""}
{"line": 474, "text": "        mask = np.triu("}
{"line": 475, "text": "            np.full("}
{"line": 476, "text": "                (seq, seq),"}
{"line": 477, "text": "                -1e9,"}
{"line": 478, "text": "                dtype=np.float32"}
{"line": 479, "text": "            ),"}
{"line": 480, "text": "            k=1"}
{"line": 481, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 482, "text": ""}
{"line": 483, "text": "        scores = scores + mask"}
{"line": 484, "text": ""}
{"line": 485, "text": "        # Stable softmax"}
{"line": 486, "text": "        scores = scores - scores.max("}
{"line": 487, "text": "            axis=-1,"}
{"line": 488, "text": "            keepdims=True"}
{"line": 489, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 490, "text": ""}
{"line": 491, "text": "        exp_scores = np.exp("}
{"line": 492, "text": "            np.clip(scores, -80.0, 0.0)"}
{"line": 493, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 494, "text": ""}
{"line": 495, "text": "        att = exp_scores / ("}
{"line": 496, "text": "            exp_scores.sum("}
{"line": 497, "text": "                axis=-1,"}
{"line": 498, "text": "                keepdims=True"}
{"line": 499, "text": "            ) + 1e-9"}
{"line": 500, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 501, "text": ""}
{"line": 502, "text": "        y = att @ v"}
{"line": 503, "text": ""}
{"line": 504, "text": "        y = y.transpose("}
{"line": 505, "text": "            0, 2, 1, 3"}
{"line": 506, "text": "        ).reshape(B, seq, C)"}
{"line": 507, "text": ""}
{"line": 508, "text": "        self.q = q"}
{"line": 509, "text": "        self.k = k"}
{"line": 510, "text": "        self.v = v"}
{"line": 511, "text": "        self.att = att"}
{"line": 512, "text": ""}
{"line": 513, "text": "        return self.proj.forward(y)"}
{"line": 514, "text": ""}
{"line": 515, "text": ""}
{"line": 516, "text": "    def backward(self, dout):"}
{"line": 517, "text": ""}
{"line": 518, "text": "        B, seq, C = dout.shape"}
{"line": 519, "text": ""}
{"line": 520, "text": "        dy = self.proj.backward(dout)"}
{"line": 521, "text": ""}
{"line": 522, "text": "        dy = dy.reshape("}
{"line": 523, "text": "            B,"}
{"line": 524, "text": "            seq,"}
{"line": 525, "text": "            self.H,"}
{"line": 526, "text": "            self.DH"}
{"line": 527, "text": "        ).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)"}
{"line": 528, "text": ""}
{"line": 529, "text": "        q = self.q"}
{"line": 530, "text": "        k = self.k"}
{"line": 531, "text": "        v = self.v"}
{"line": 532, "text": "        att = self.att"}
{"line": 533, "text": ""}
{"line": 534, "text": "        # y = att @ v"}
{"line": 535, "text": "        datt = ("}
{"line": 536, "text": "            dy @ v.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)"}
{"line": 537, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 538, "text": ""}
{"line": 539, "text": "        dv = ("}
{"line": 540, "text": "            att.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)"}
{"line": 541, "text": "            @ dy"}
{"line": 542, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 543, "text": ""}
{"line": 544, "text": "        # Stable softmax backward"}
{"line": 545, "text": "        dscore = att * ("}
{"line": 546, "text": "            datt"}
{"line": 547, "text": "            - ("}
{"line": 548, "text": "                datt * att"}
{"line": 549, "text": "            ).sum("}
{"line": 550, "text": "                axis=-1,"}
{"line": 551, "text": "                keepdims=True"}
{"line": 552, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 553, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 554, "text": ""}
{"line": 555, "text": "        # scores = (q @ k.T) * scale"}
{"line": 556, "text": "        dq = ("}
{"line": 557, "text": "            dscore @ k"}
{"line": 558, "text": "        ) * self.scale"}
{"line": 559, "text": ""}
{"line": 560, "text": "        dk = ("}
{"line": 561, "text": "            dscore.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)"}
{"line": 562, "text": "            @ q"}
{"line": 563, "text": "        ) * self.scale"}
{"line": 564, "text": ""}
{"line": 565, "text": "        # Exact inverse RoPE"}
{"line": 566, "text": "        dq = rope_inverse("}
{"line": 567, "text": "            dq,"}
{"line": 568, "text": "            self.rope_cos,"}
{"line": 569, "text": "            self.rope_sin"}
{"line": 570, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 571, "text": ""}
{"line": 572, "text": "        dk = rope_inverse("}
{"line": 573, "text": "            dk,"}
{"line": 574, "text": "            self.rope_cos,"}
{"line": 575, "text": "            self.rope_sin"}
{"line": 576, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 577, "text": ""}
{"line": 578, "text": "        dq = dq.transpose("}
{"line": 579, "text": "            0, 2, 1, 3"}
{"line": 580, "text": "        ).reshape(B, seq, C)"}
{"line": 581, "text": ""}
{"line": 582, "text": "        dk = dk.transpose("}
{"line": 583, "text": "            0, 2, 1, 3"}
{"line": 584, "text": "        ).reshape(B, seq, C)"}
{"line": 585, "text": ""}
{"line": 586, "text": "        dv = dv.transpose("}
{"line": 587, "text": "            0, 2, 1, 3"}
{"line": 588, "text": "        ).reshape(B, seq, C)"}
{"line": 589, "text": ""}
{"line": 590, "text": "        return self.qkv.backward("}
{"line": 591, "text": "            np.concatenate("}
{"line": 592, "text": "                [dq, dk, dv],"}
{"line": 593, "text": "                axis=-1"}
{"line": 594, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 595, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 596, "text": ""}
{"line": 597, "text": ""}
{"line": 598, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 599, "text": "# MLP"}
{"line": 600, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 601, "text": ""}
{"line": 602, "text": "class MLP:"}
{"line": 603, "text": ""}
{"line": 604, "text": "    def __init__(self, D):"}
{"line": 605, "text": ""}
{"line": 606, "text": "        self.fc1 = Linear(D, 4 * D)"}
{"line": 607, "text": "        self.fc2 = Linear(4 * D, D)"}
{"line": 608, "text": ""}
{"line": 609, "text": "        self.h = None"}
{"line": 610, "text": ""}
{"line": 611, "text": ""}
{"line": 612, "text": "    def forward(self, x):"}
{"line": 613, "text": ""}
{"line": 614, "text": "        h = self.fc1.forward(x)"}
{"line": 615, "text": ""}
{"line": 616, "text": "        # GELU approximation"}
{"line": 617, "text": "        self.h = h"}
{"line": 618, "text": ""}
{"line": 619, "text": "        c = np.sqrt("}
{"line": 620, "text": "            2.0 / np.pi"}
{"line": 621, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 622, "text": ""}
{"line": 623, "text": "        u = c * ("}
{"line": 624, "text": "            h + 0.044715 * h ** 3"}
{"line": 625, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 626, "text": ""}
{"line": 627, "text": "        return self.fc2.forward("}
{"line": 628, "text": "            0.5 * h * ("}
{"line": 629, "text": "                1.0 + np.tanh(u)"}
{"line": 630, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 631, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 632, "text": ""}
{"line": 633, "text": ""}
{"line": 634, "text": "    def backward(self, dout):"}
{"line": 635, "text": ""}
{"line": 636, "text": "        dh = self.fc2.backward(dout)"}
{"line": 637, "text": ""}
{"line": 638, "text": "        h = self.h"}
{"line": 639, "text": ""}
{"line": 640, "text": "        c = np.sqrt("}
{"line": 641, "text": "            2.0 / np.pi"}
{"line": 642, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 643, "text": ""}
{"line": 644, "text": "        u = c * ("}
{"line": 645, "text": "            h + 0.044715 * h ** 3"}
{"line": 646, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 647, "text": ""}
{"line": 648, "text": "        tanh_u = np.tanh(u)"}
{"line": 649, "text": ""}
{"line": 650, "text": "        du = c * ("}
{"line": 651, "text": "            1.0 + 3.0 * 0.044715 * h ** 2"}
{"line": 652, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 653, "text": ""}
{"line": 654, "text": "        gelu_grad = ("}
{"line": 655, "text": "            0.5 * ("}
{"line": 656, "text": "                1.0 + tanh_u"}
{"line": 657, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 658, "text": "            + 0.5 * h * ("}
{"line": 659, "text": "                1.0 - tanh_u ** 2"}
{"line": 660, "text": "            ) * du"}
{"line": 661, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 662, "text": ""}
{"line": 663, "text": "        return self.fc1.backward("}
{"line": 664, "text": "            dh * gelu_grad"}
{"line": 665, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 666, "text": ""}
{"line": 667, "text": ""}
{"line": 668, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 669, "text": "# BLOCK"}
{"line": 670, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 671, "text": ""}
{"line": 672, "text": "class Block:"}
{"line": 673, "text": ""}
{"line": 674, "text": "    def __init__("}
{"line": 675, "text": "        self,"}
{"line": 676, "text": "        D,"}
{"line": 677, "text": "        H,"}
{"line": 678, "text": "        rope_cos,"}
{"line": 679, "text": "        rope_sin"}
{"line": 680, "text": "    ):"}
{"line": 681, "text": ""}
{"line": 682, "text": "        self.ln1 = LayerNorm(D)"}
{"line": 683, "text": ""}
{"line": 684, "text": "        self.attn = CausalSelfAttention("}
{"line": 685, "text": "            D,"}
{"line": 686, "text": "            H,"}
{"line": 687, "text": "            rope_cos,"}
{"line": 688, "text": "            rope_sin"}
{"line": 689, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 690, "text": ""}
{"line": 691, "text": "        self.ln2 = LayerNorm(D)"}
{"line": 692, "text": ""}
{"line": 693, "text": "        self.mlp = MLP(D)"}
{"line": 694, "text": ""}
{"line": 695, "text": ""}
{"line": 696, "text": "    def forward(self, x):"}
{"line": 697, "text": ""}
{"line": 698, "text": "        x = x + self.attn.forward("}
{"line": 699, "text": "            self.ln1.forward(x)"}
{"line": 700, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 701, "text": ""}
{"line": 702, "text": "        x = x + self.mlp.forward("}
{"line": 703, "text": "            self.ln2.forward(x)"}
{"line": 704, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 705, "text": ""}
{"line": 706, "text": "        return x"}
{"line": 707, "text": ""}
{"line": 708, "text": ""}
{"line": 709, "text": "    def backward(self, dout):"}
{"line": 710, "text": ""}
{"line": 711, "text": "        d_mlp = self.mlp.backward(dout)"}
{"line": 712, "text": ""}
{"line": 713, "text": "        d_ln2 = self.ln2.backward(d_mlp)"}
{"line": 714, "text": ""}
{"line": 715, "text": "        d_after_attn = dout + d_ln2"}
{"line": 716, "text": ""}
{"line": 717, "text": "        d_attn = self.attn.backward("}
{"line": 718, "text": "            d_after_attn"}
{"line": 719, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 720, "text": ""}
{"line": 721, "text": "        d_ln1 = self.ln1.backward(d_attn)"}
{"line": 722, "text": ""}
{"line": 723, "text": "        return d_after_attn + d_ln1"}
{"line": 724, "text": ""}
{"line": 725, "text": ""}
{"line": 726, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 727, "text": "# GPT"}
{"line": 728, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 729, "text": ""}
{"line": 730, "text": "class GPT:"}
{"line": 731, "text": ""}
{"line": 732, "text": "    def __init__(self, vs, D, H, L, T):"}
{"line": 733, "text": ""}
{"line": 734, "text": "        self.T = T"}
{"line": 735, "text": ""}
{"line": 736, "text": "        self.wte = randn(vs, D)"}
{"line": 737, "text": ""}
{"line": 738, "text": "        rope_cos, rope_sin = precompute_rope("}
{"line": 739, "text": "            D // H,"}
{"line": 740, "text": "            T"}
{"line": 741, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 742, "text": ""}
{"line": 743, "text": "        self.blocks = ["}
{"line": 744, "text": "            Block("}
{"line": 745, "text": "                D,"}
{"line": 746, "text": "                H,"}
{"line": 747, "text": "                rope_cos,"}
{"line": 748, "text": "                rope_sin"}
{"line": 749, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 750, "text": "            for _ in range(L)"}
{"line": 751, "text": "        ]"}
{"line": 752, "text": ""}
{"line": 753, "text": "        self.ln_f = LayerNorm(D)"}
{"line": 754, "text": ""}
{"line": 755, "text": "        self.lm_head = Linear("}
{"line": 756, "text": "            D,"}
{"line": 757, "text": "            vs,"}
{"line": 758, "text": "            bias=False"}
{"line": 759, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 760, "text": ""}
{"line": 761, "text": "        # True tied weights"}
{"line": 762, "text": "        self.lm_head.W = self.wte.T"}
{"line": 763, "text": ""}
{"line": 764, "text": "        self.idx = None"}
{"line": 765, "text": "        self.probs = None"}
{"line": 766, "text": "        self.targets = None"}
{"line": 767, "text": ""}
{"line": 768, "text": "        self.d_wte = zeros(vs, D)"}
{"line": 769, "text": ""}
{"line": 770, "text": ""}
{"line": 771, "text": "    def forward(self, idx, targets=None):"}
{"line": 772, "text": ""}
{"line": 773, "text": "        B, seq = idx.shape"}
{"line": 774, "text": ""}
{"line": 775, "text": "        if seq != self.T:"}
{"line": 776, "text": "            raise ValueError("}
{"line": 777, "text": "                f\"Expected context {self.T}, got {seq}\""}
{"line": 778, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 779, "text": ""}
{"line": 780, "text": "        self.idx = idx"}
{"line": 781, "text": ""}
{"line": 782, "text": "        x = self.wte[idx]"}
{"line": 783, "text": ""}
{"line": 784, "text": "        for block in self.blocks:"}
{"line": 785, "text": "            x = block.forward(x)"}
{"line": 786, "text": ""}
{"line": 787, "text": "        x = self.ln_f.forward(x)"}
{"line": 788, "text": ""}
{"line": 789, "text": "        logits = self.lm_head.forward(x)"}
{"line": 790, "text": ""}
{"line": 791, "text": "        loss = None"}
{"line": 792, "text": ""}
{"line": 793, "text": "        if targets is not None:"}
{"line": 794, "text": ""}
{"line": 795, "text": "            flat = logits.reshape("}
{"line": 796, "text": "                -1,"}
{"line": 797, "text": "                logits.shape[-1]"}
{"line": 798, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 799, "text": ""}
{"line": 800, "text": "            flat = flat - flat.max("}
{"line": 801, "text": "                axis=1,"}
{"line": 802, "text": "                keepdims=True"}
{"line": 803, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 804, "text": ""}
{"line": 805, "text": "            exp = np.exp("}
{"line": 806, "text": "                np.clip(flat, -80.0, 0.0)"}
{"line": 807, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 808, "text": ""}
{"line": 809, "text": "            probs = exp / ("}
{"line": 810, "text": "                exp.sum("}
{"line": 811, "text": "                    axis=1,"}
{"line": 812, "text": "                    keepdims=True"}
{"line": 813, "text": "                ) + 1e-9"}
{"line": 814, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 815, "text": ""}
{"line": 816, "text": "            target_flat = targets.reshape(-1)"}
{"line": 817, "text": ""}
{"line": 818, "text": "            loss = -np.log("}
{"line": 819, "text": "                probs["}
{"line": 820, "text": "                    np.arange(B * seq),"}
{"line": 821, "text": "                    target_flat"}
{"line": 822, "text": "                ] + 1e-9"}
{"line": 823, "text": "            ).mean()"}
{"line": 824, "text": ""}
{"line": 825, "text": "            self.probs = probs.reshape("}
{"line": 826, "text": "                B,"}
{"line": 827, "text": "                seq,"}
{"line": 828, "text": "                -1"}
{"line": 829, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 830, "text": ""}
{"line": 831, "text": "            self.targets = targets"}
{"line": 832, "text": ""}
{"line": 833, "text": "        return logits, float(loss) if loss is not None else None"}
{"line": 834, "text": ""}
{"line": 835, "text": ""}
{"line": 836, "text": "    def backward(self):"}
{"line": 837, "text": ""}
{"line": 838, "text": "        B, seq, V = self.probs.shape"}
{"line": 839, "text": ""}
{"line": 840, "text": "        dlogits = self.probs.copy()"}
{"line": 841, "text": ""}
{"line": 842, "text": "        dlogits.reshape("}
{"line": 843, "text": "            -1,"}
{"line": 844, "text": "            V"}
{"line": 845, "text": "        )["}
{"line": 846, "text": "            np.arange(B * seq),"}
{"line": 847, "text": "            self.targets.reshape(-1)"}
{"line": 848, "text": "        ] -= 1.0"}
{"line": 849, "text": ""}
{"line": 850, "text": "        dlogits /= ("}
{"line": 851, "text": "            B * seq"}
{"line": 852, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 853, "text": ""}
{"line": 854, "text": "        dx = self.lm_head.backward("}
{"line": 855, "text": "            dlogits"}
{"line": 856, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 857, "text": ""}
{"line": 858, "text": "        dx = self.ln_f.backward(dx)"}
{"line": 859, "text": ""}
{"line": 860, "text": "        for block in reversed(self.blocks):"}
{"line": 861, "text": "            dx = block.backward(dx)"}
{"line": 862, "text": ""}
{"line": 863, "text": "        d_wte = zeros(*self.wte.shape)"}
{"line": 864, "text": ""}
{"line": 865, "text": "        np.add.at("}
{"line": 866, "text": "            d_wte,"}
{"line": 867, "text": "            self.idx.reshape(-1),"}
{"line": 868, "text": "            dx.reshape(-1, dx.shape[-1])"}
{"line": 869, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 870, "text": ""}
{"line": 871, "text": "        # Output head gradient belongs to tied embedding matrix."}
{"line": 872, "text": "        d_wte += self.lm_head.dW.T"}
{"line": 873, "text": ""}
{"line": 874, "text": "        self.d_wte[:] = d_wte"}
{"line": 875, "text": ""}
{"line": 876, "text": ""}

{"line": 1008, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 1009, "text": "# NUMERICAL GRADIENT CHECK"}
{"line": 1010, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 1011, "text": ""}
{"line": 1012, "text": "print(\"[CHECK] Running pre-training finite diagnostic...\")"}
{"line": 1013, "text": ""}
{"line": 1014, "text": "test_x, test_y = get_batch()"}
{"line": 1015, "text": ""}
{"line": 1016, "text": "_, test_loss = model.forward("}
{"line": 1017, "text": "    test_x,"}
{"line": 1018, "text": "    test_y"}
{"line": 1019, "text": ")"}
{"line": 1020, "text": ""}
{"line": 1021, "text": "model.backward()"}
{"line": 1022, "text": ""}
{"line": 1023, "text": "check_finite("}
{"line": 1024, "text": "    \"initial_loss\","}
{"line": 1025, "text": "    np.array(test_loss)"}
{"line": 1026, "text": ")"}
{"line": 1027, "text": ""}
{"line": 1028, "text": "for name, _, grad in params:"}
{"line": 1029, "text": "    check_finite("}
{"line": 1030, "text": "        f\"grad:{name}\","}
{"line": 1031, "text": "        grad"}
{"line": 1032, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 1033, "text": ""}
{"line": 1034, "text": "grad_norm_sq = sum("}
{"line": 1035, "text": "    float(np.sum(grad.astype(np.float64) ** 2))"}
{"line": 1036, "text": "    for _, _, grad in params"}
{"line": 1037, "text": ")"}
{"line": 1038, "text": ""}
{"line": 1039, "text": "initial_grad_norm = math.sqrt(grad_norm_sq)"}
{"line": 1040, "text": ""}
{"line": 1041, "text": "print("}
{"line": 1042, "text": "    f\"[CHECK] PASS \""}
{"line": 1043, "text": "    f\"loss={test_loss:.6f} \""}
{"line": 1044, "text": "    f\"grad_norm={initial_grad_norm:.6f}\""}
{"line": 1045, "text": ")"}
{"line": 1046, "text": ""}
{"line": 1047, "text": ""}
{"line": 1048, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 1049, "text": "# ADAM + GLOBAL GRADIENT CLIPPING"}
{"line": 1050, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 1051, "text": ""}
{"line": 1052, "text": "adam_m = {"}
{"line": 1053, "text": "    name: zeros(*p.shape)"}
{"line": 1054, "text": "    for name, p, _ in params"}
{"line": 1055, "text": "}"}
{"line": 1056, "text": ""}
{"line": 1057, "text": "adam_v = {"}
{"line": 1058, "text": "    name: zeros(*p.shape)"}
{"line": 1059, "text": "    for name, p, _ in params"}
{"line": 1060, "text": "}"}
{"line": 1061, "text": ""}
{"line": 1062, "text": ""}
{"line": 1063, "text": "def apply_grads(step, lr):"}
{"line": 1064, "text": ""}
{"line": 1065, "text": "    global_norm_sq = 0.0"}
{"line": 1066, "text": ""}
{"line": 1067, "text": "    for _, _, grad in params:"}
{"line": 1068, "text": ""}
{"line": 1069, "text": "        check_finite("}
{"line": 1070, "text": "            \"gradient\","}
{"line": 1071, "text": "            grad"}
{"line": 1072, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1073, "text": ""}
{"line": 1074, "text": "        global_norm_sq += float("}
{"line": 1075, "text": "            np.sum("}
{"line": 1076, "text": "                grad.astype(np.float64) ** 2"}
{"line": 1077, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 1078, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1079, "text": ""}
{"line": 1080, "text": "    global_norm = math.sqrt("}
{"line": 1081, "text": "        global_norm_sq"}
{"line": 1082, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 1083, "text": ""}
{"line": 1084, "text": "    clip_coef = min("}
{"line": 1085, "text": "        1.0,"}
{"line": 1086, "text": "        MAX_GRAD_NORM / ("}
{"line": 1087, "text": "            global_norm + 1e-12"}
{"line": 1088, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1089, "text": "    )"}
{"line": 1090, "text": ""}
{"line": 1091, "text": "    for name, param, grad in params:"}
{"line": 1092, "text": ""}
{"line": 1093, "text": "        g = grad * clip_coef"}
{"line": 1094, "text": ""}
{"line": 1095, "text": "        m = adam_m[name]"}
{"line": 1096, "text": "        v = adam_v[name]"}
{"line": 1097, "text": ""}
{"line": 1098, "text": "        m[:] = ("}
{"line": 1099, "text": "            BETA1 * m"}
{"line": 1100, "text": "            + (1.0 - BETA1) * g"}
{"line": 1101, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1102, "text": ""}
{"line": 1103, "text": "        v[:] = ("}
{"line": 1104, "text": "            BETA2 * v"}
{"line": 1105, "text": "            + (1.0 - BETA2) * (g * g)"}
{"line": 1106, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1107, "text": ""}
{"line": 1108, "text": "        m_hat = m / ("}
{"line": 1109, "text": "            1.0 - BETA1 ** step"}
{"line": 1110, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1111, "text": ""}
{"line": 1112, "text": "        v_hat = v / ("}
{"line": 1113, "text": "            1.0 - BETA2 ** step"}
{"line": 1114, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1115, "text": ""}
{"line": 1116, "text": "        # Weight decay only for matrices."}
{"line": 1117, "text": "        if param.ndim >= 2:"}
{"line": 1118, "text": "            param *= ("}
{"line": 1119, "text": "                1.0"}
{"line": 1120, "text": "                - lr * WEIGHT_DECAY"}
{"line": 1121, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 1122, "text": ""}
{"line": 1123, "text": "        param -= ("}
{"line": 1124, "text": "            lr"}
{"line": 1125, "text": "            * m_hat"}
{"line": 1126, "text": "            / ("}
{"line": 1127, "text": "                np.sqrt(v_hat) + EPS"}
{"line": 1128, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 1129, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1130, "text": ""}
{"line": 1131, "text": "        check_finite("}
{"line": 1132, "text": "            f\"parameter:{name}\","}
{"line": 1133, "text": "            param"}
{"line": 1134, "text": "        )"}
{"line": 1135, "text": ""}
{"line": 1136, "text": "    # Preserve exact weight tying."}
{"line": 1137, "text": "    model.lm_head.W = model.wte.T"}
{"line": 1138, "text": ""}
{"line": 1139, "text": "    return global_norm, clip_coef"}
{"line": 1140, "text": ""}
{"line": 1141, "text": ""}
{"line": 1142, "text": "# ============================================================"}
{"line": 1143, "text": "# CHECKPOINT"}

{"line": 1273, "text": "archive_texts = []"}
{"line": 1274, "text": ""}

{"line": 150, "text": "def parse_python(path: Path):"}
{"line": 151, "text": "    try:"}
{"line": 152, "text": "        text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")"}
{"line": 153, "text": "        tree = ast.parse(text, filename=str(path))"}
{"line": 154, "text": "        return text, tree, None"}
{"line": 155, "text": "    except Exception as e:"}
{"line": 156, "text": "        return \"\", None, repr(e)"}
{"line": 157, "text": ""}

{"line": 159, "text": "def ast_symbols(path: Path):"}
{"line": 160, "text": "    text, tree, error = parse_python(path)"}
{"line": 161, "text": ""}
{"line": 162, "text": "    result = {"}
{"line": 163, "text": "        \"path\": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),"}
{"line": 164, "text": "        \"functions\": [],"}
{"line": 165, "text": "        \"classes\": [],"}
{"line": 166, "text": "        \"imports\": [],"}
{"line": 167, "text": "        \"assignments\": [],"}
{"line": 168, "text": "        \"calls\": [],"}
{"line": 169, "text": "        \"parse_error\": error,"}
{"line": 170, "text": "    }"}
{"line": 171, "text": ""}
{"line": 172, "text": "    if tree is None:"}
{"line": 173, "text": "        return result"}
{"line": 174, "text": ""}
{"line": 175, "text": "    for node in ast.walk(tree):"}
{"line": 176, "text": "        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):"}
{"line": 177, "text": "            result[\"functions\"].append({"}
{"line": 178, "text": "                \"name\": node.name,"}
{"line": 179, "text": "                \"line\": node.lineno,"}
{"line": 180, "text": "                \"end_line\": getattr(node, \"end_lineno\", node.lineno),"}
{"line": 181, "text": "            })"}
{"line": 182, "text": ""}
{"line": 183, "text": "        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):"}
{"line": 184, "text": "            result[\"classes\"].append({"}
{"line": 185, "text": "                \"name\": node.name,"}
{"line": 186, "text": "                \"line\": node.lineno,"}
{"line": 187, "text": "                \"end_line\": getattr(node, \"end_lineno\", node.lineno),"}
{"line": 188, "text": "            })"}
{"line": 189, "text": ""}
{"line": 190, "text": "        elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):"}
{"line": 191, "text": "            for alias in node.names:"}
{"line": 192, "text": "                result[\"imports\"].append(alias.name)"}
{"line": 193, "text": ""}
{"line": 194, "text": "        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):"}
{"line": 195, "text": "            result[\"imports\"].append("}
{"line": 196, "text": "                f\"{node.module or ''}:{','.join(a.name for a in node.names)}\""}
{"line": 197, "text": "            )"}
{"line": 198, "text": ""}
{"line": 199, "text": "        elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign):"}
{"line": 200, "text": "            for target in node.targets:"}
{"line": 201, "text": "                if isinstance(target, ast.Name):"}
{"line": 202, "text": "                    result[\"assignments\"].append({"}
{"line": 203, "text": "                        \"name\": target.id,"}
{"line": 204, "text": "                        \"line\": node.lineno,"}
{"line": 205, "text": "                    })"}
{"line": 206, "text": ""}
{"line": 207, "text": "        elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):"}
{"line": 208, "text": "            if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):"}
{"line": 209, "text": "                name = node.func.id"}
{"line": 210, "text": "            elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):"}
{"line": 211, "text": "                name = node.func.attr"}
{"line": 212, "text": "            else:"}
{"line": 213, "text": "                name = \"<unknown>\""}
{"line": 214, "text": ""}
{"line": 215, "text": "            result[\"calls\"].append({"}
{"line": 216, "text": "                \"name\": name,"}
{"line": 217, "text": "                \"line\": node.lineno,"}
{"line": 218, "text": "            })"}
{"line": 219, "text": ""}
{"line": 220, "text": "    return result"}
{"line": 221, "text": ""}

{"line": 328, "text": "                \"load\","}
{"line": 329, "text": "                \"generate\","}
{"line": 330, "text": "                \"initialize\","}
{"line": 331, "text": "                \"init\","}

{"line": 338, "text": "            )"}

{"line": 340, "text": "            consumer_words = ("}

{"line": 406, "text": "            \"contract\": \"runtime_vocabulary\","}

{"line": 410, "text": "            \"fabrication_allowed\": False,"}
{"line": 411, "text": "        })"}
{"line": 412, "text": ""}
{"line": 413, "text": "    model_mentions = len(model)"}
{"line": 414, "text": ""}
{"line": 415, "text": "    if model_mentions == 0:"}
{"line": 416, "text": "        failures.append({"}
{"line": 417, "text": "            \"severity\": \"HIGH\","}
{"line": 418, "text": "            \"contract\": \"model\","}
{"line": 419, "text": "            \"problem\": \"No model contract evidence was found in Python source.\","}
{"line": 420, "text": "            \"required_action\": \"Trace runtime imports and model initialization.\","}
{"line": 421, "text": "            \"fabrication_allowed\": False,"}
{"line": 422, "text": "        })"}
{"line": 423, "text": ""}
{"line": 424, "text": "    return failures"}

{"line": 1, "text": "import numpy as np, pathlib"}
{"line": 2, "text": "p=pathlib.Path.home()/\"BLOOM\"/\"my_texts.txt\""}
{"line": 3, "text": "raw=p.read_text() if p.exists() else \"East Point, Georgia. BLOOM is the best LLM on Termux. It learns Shakespeare and my thoughts. \""}
{"line": 4, "text": "txt=raw*400"}
{"line": 5, "text": "chars=sorted(set(txt))"}
{"line": 6, "text": "vs=len(chars)"}
{"line": 7, "text": "stoi={c:i for i,c in enumerate(chars)}"}
{"line": 8, "text": "itos={i:c for i,c in enumerate(chars)}"}
{"line": 9, "text": "data=np.array([stoi[c] for c in txt], dtype=np.int32)"}
{"line": 10, "text": "H=128"}
{"line": 11, "text": "T=64"}
{"line": 12, "text": "np.random.seed(0)"}
{"line": 13, "text": "Wxh=np.random.randn(vs,H)*0.02"}
{"line": 14, "text": "Whh=np.random.randn(H,H)*0.02"}
{"line": 15, "text": "Why=np.random.randn(H,vs)*0.02"}
{"line": 16, "text": "bh=np.zeros(H)"}
{"line": 17, "text": "by=np.zeros(vs)"}
{"line": 18, "text": ""}
{"line": 19, "text": "def step(x,h):"}
{"line": 20, "text": "    return np.tanh(Wxh.T@x + Whh.T@h + bh[:,None])"}
{"line": 21, "text": ""}
{"line": 22, "text": "h=np.zeros((H,1))"}
{"line": 23, "text": "for it in range(4000):"}
{"line": 24, "text": "    s=np.random.randint(0, len(data)-T-1)"}
{"line": 25, "text": "    xs=data[s:s+T]"}
{"line": 26, "text": "    ys=data[s+1:s+T+1]"}
{"line": 27, "text": "    hs={}"}
{"line": 28, "text": "    hs[-1]=h"}
{"line": 29, "text": "    for t in range(T):"}
{"line": 30, "text": "        xv=np.zeros((vs,1)); xv[xs[t]]=1"}
{"line": 31, "text": "        hs[t]=np.tanh(Wxh.T@xv + Whh.T@hs[t-1] + bh[:,None])"}
{"line": 32, "text": "    dWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); dWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); dWhy=np.zeros_like(Why)"}
{"line": 33, "text": "    dbh=np.zeros_like(bh); dby=np.zeros_like(by)"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    dh_next=np.zeros((H,1))"}
{"line": 35, "text": "    loss=0"}
{"line": 36, "text": "    for t in reversed(range(T)):"}
{"line": 37, "text": "        y=Why.T@hs[t]+by[:,None]"}
{"line": 38, "text": "        y=y-y.max()"}
{"line": 39, "text": "        e=np.exp(y); e=e/e.sum()"}
{"line": 40, "text": "        loss-=np.log(e[ys[t],0]+1e-9)"}
{"line": 41, "text": "        dy=e.copy(); dy[ys[t]]-=1"}
{"line": 42, "text": "        dWhy+=hs[t]@dy.T"}
{"line": 43, "text": "        dby+=dy.ravel()"}
{"line": 44, "text": "        dh=Why@dy+dh_next"}
{"line": 45, "text": "        dh_raw=(1-hs[t]**2)*dh"}
{"line": 46, "text": "        dbh+=dh_raw.ravel()"}
{"line": 47, "text": "        xv=np.zeros((vs,1)); xv[xs[t]]=1"}
{"line": 48, "text": "        dWxh+=xv@dh_raw.T"}
{"line": 49, "text": "        dWhh+=hs[t-1]@dh_raw.T"}
{"line": 50, "text": "        dh_next=Whh@dh_raw"}
{"line": 51, "text": "    Wxh-=0.01*dWxh/T; Whh-=0.01*dWhh/T; Why-=0.01*dWhy/T; bh-=0.01*dbh/T; by-=0.01*dby/T"}
{"line": 52, "text": "    h=hs[T-1]"}
{"line": 53, "text": "    if it%500==0:"}
{"line": 54, "text": "        print(it, round(loss/T,3))"}
{"line": 55, "text": ""}
{"line": 56, "text": "def gen(prompt, n=250):"}
{"line": 57, "text": "    h2=np.zeros((H,1))"}
{"line": 58, "text": "    for c in prompt:"}
{"line": 59, "text": "        if c not in stoi: continue"}
{"line": 60, "text": "        xv=np.zeros((vs,1)); xv[stoi[c]]=1"}
{"line": 61, "text": "        h2=np.tanh(Wxh.T@xv + Whh.T@h2 + bh[:,None])"}
{"line": 62, "text": "    out=prompt"}
{"line": 63, "text": "    xv=np.zeros((vs,1)); xv[stoi[prompt[-1]]]=1"}
{"line": 64, "text": "    for _ in range(n):"}
{"line": 65, "text": "        h2=np.tanh(Wxh.T@xv + Whh.T@h2 + bh[:,None])"}
{"line": 66, "text": "        y=Why.T@h2+by[:,None]"}
{"line": 67, "text": "        idx=int(np.argmax(y))"}
{"line": 68, "text": "        out+=itos[idx]"}
{"line": 69, "text": "        xv=np.zeros((vs,1)); xv[idx]=1"}
{"line": 70, "text": "    return out"}
{"line": 71, "text": ""}
{"line": 72, "text": "print(\"ready - deterministic argmax\")"}
{"line": 73, "text": "while True:"}
{"line": 74, "text": "    q=input(\"\\n> \")"}
{"line": 75, "text": "    if q in (\"exit\",\"quit\"): break"}
{"line": 76, "text": "    print(gen(q, 300))"}

{"line": 11, "text": "bh=np.zeros(hidden); by=np.zeros(vs)"}
{"line": 12, "text": "mWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); mWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); mWhy=np.zeros_like(Why); mbh=np.zeros_like(bh); mby=np.zeros_like(by)"}
{"line": 13, "text": "vWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); vWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); vWhy=np.zeros_like(Why); vbh=np.zeros_like(bh); vby=np.zeros_like(by)"}
{"line": 14, "text": "def forward(xs,h0):"}
{"line": 15, "text": "    T,B=xs.shape; h=np.zeros((T+1,B,hidden)); h[0]=h0; logits=np.zeros((T,B,vs))"}
{"line": 16, "text": "    for t in range(T): h[t+1]=np.tanh(Wxh[xs[t]] + h[t]@Whh + bh); logits[t]=h[t+1]@Why+by"}
{"line": 17, "text": "    return logits,h"}
{"line": 18, "text": "def loss_grad(logits,targets,h,xs):"}
{"line": 19, "text": "    T,B,_=logits.shape; m=np.max(logits,axis=-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(logits-m); p=e/np.sum(e,axis=-1,keepdims=True)"}
{"line": 20, "text": "    loss=-np.mean(np.log(p[np.arange(T)[:,None], np.arange(B), targets]+1e-8))"}
{"line": 21, "text": "    dlog=p.copy(); dlog[np.arange(T)[:,None], np.arange(B), targets]-=1; dlog/=T*B"}
{"line": 22, "text": "    dWhy=np.zeros_like(Why); dby=np.zeros_like(by); dWxh=np.zeros_like(Wxh); dWhh=np.zeros_like(Whh); dbh=np.zeros_like(bh); dh_next=np.zeros((B,hidden))"}
{"line": 23, "text": "    for t in reversed(range(T)):"}
{"line": 24, "text": "        dl=dlog[t]; dWhy+=h[t+1].T@dl; dby+=dl.sum(0); dh=dl@Why.T+dh_next; dh_raw=dh*(1-h[t+1]**2); dbh+=dh_raw.sum(0); dWhh+=h[t].T@dh_raw"}
{"line": 25, "text": "        for b in range(B): dWxh[xs[t,b]]+=dh_raw[b]"}
{"line": 26, "text": "        dh_next=dh_raw@Whh.T"}
{"line": 27, "text": "    return loss,dWxh,dWhh,dWhy,dbh,dby"}
{"line": 28, "text": ""}
{"line": 29, "text": "best=10"}
{"line": 30, "text": "for it in range(1,5000):"}
{"line": 31, "text": "    idx=np.random.randint(0,len(data)-block-1,size=batch)"}
{"line": 32, "text": "    xs=np.zeros((block,batch),dtype=int); ys=np.zeros((block,batch),dtype=int)"}
{"line": 33, "text": "    for b,i in enumerate(idx): xs[:,b]=data[i:i+block]; ys[:,b]=data[i+1:i+block+1]"}
{"line": 34, "text": "    logits,h=forward(xs,np.zeros((batch,hidden)))"}
{"line": 35, "text": "    loss,dWxh,dWhh,dWhy,dbh,dby=loss_grad(logits,ys,h,xs)"}
{"line": 36, "text": "    for par,m,v,d in [(Wxh,mWxh,vWxh,dWxh),(Whh,mWhh,vWhh,dWhh),(Why,mWhy,vWhy,dWhy),(bh,mbh,vbh,dbh),(by,mby,vby,dby)]:"}
{"line": 37, "text": "        m[:]=0.9*m+0.1*d; v[:]=0.999*v+0.001*d*d"}
{"line": 38, "text": "        par-=0.003*(m/(1-0.9**it))/(np.sqrt(v/(1-0.999**it))+1e-8)"}
{"line": 39, "text": "    if it%100==0:"}
{"line": 40, "text": "        np.savez(\"garden_best_llm/W.npz\",Wxh=Wxh,Whh=Whh,Why=Why,bh=bh,by=by)"}
{"line": 41, "text": "        cur=np.array([[stoi['\\n']]]); hs=np.zeros((1,hidden)); out=\"\\n\""}
{"line": 42, "text": "        for _ in range(200):"}
{"line": 43, "text": "            lg,hf=forward(cur,hs); hs=hf[-1]; pr=np.exp(lg[-1]-np.max(lg[-1])); pr/=pr.sum(); nxt=np.random.choice(vs,p=pr[0]); out+=itos[nxt]; cur=np.array([[nxt]])"}
{"line": 44, "text": "        print(f\"{it} loss {loss:.3f} best {best:.3f} saved\\n{out[:200]}\\n---\"); best=min(best,loss)"}
